messages:
tara: Quick internal: MuxStream (multiplexed realtime sessions) + terra-small-2b are GA on Hosted API as of now. Rolling external announce after 1h if canary stays green. :tada:

tara: Why this matters: single websocket session can now host multiple logical conversations (channels) with per-channel ordering and independent tool invocations. Expected win: fewer connections, reduced cold-starts for mobile apps, and lower connection-related cost.

mike: Wire changes: new query param `mux=true` on websocket connect and per-message envelope `channel_id`. We also added header `x-rw-channel` in HTTP streaming fallbacks. Old single-session behavior still supported without `mux`.

doc-bot: Migration guide & examples: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/muxstream-ga  includes React Native + Go examples and a migration checklist.

infra-bot: Rollout plan: canary us-east-1 (30m) -> us-west-2 (2h) -> global. Watch `mux.connections`, `mux.reassembly.errors`, and `connection.latency.p95`. Page eng-oncall if `mux.reassembly.errors` > 0.5% for 5m.

billing-bot: New billing metric: `mux_connection_minute` for active multiplexed sessions. Were grandfathering existing customers for 45 days and mapping previous websocket minutes to the new metric for that window.

mike: Quick smoke WS connect example:
```
# connect with mux enabled
wscat -c "wss://api.redwood.ai/realtime?mux=true" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY"
# send message on channel A
{
  "channel_id":"chat-A",
  "type":"input",
  "input":"Summarize the meeting notes"
}
```

tara: Action items: docs to publish (doc-bot), SDKs to add helpers for `channel_id` (mike), infra to monitor canary (infra-bot), finance to notify sales (billing-bot).

infra-bot: Canary update at 2161122390: us-east-1 canary OK, no alerts. Proceeding with staged rollout.

tara: Thanks all  external post scheduled in 1h unless any blocker appears. Ping me for urgent issues.
